name: Cruxbook
summary: A money and people back office for a group of climbing gyms, with a morphing cash-flow chart
about: A back office for a business with several locations, shown with three climbing gyms. Owners, office managers and bookkeepers see cash, takings, payroll, expense claims and documents in one place. The cash-flow chart morphs between net bars, money in and out, and a running bank balance, on a chalkboard or limestone theme.
how: Switch the cash-flow chart between Net, In & out and Balance: the bars reshape into each other and the balance line rises out of them.
Change the range between 30D, 12W and 12M, or pick one gym in the top bar, and the chart, totals and pages follow.
On Payroll, edit hours for hourly staff and watch gross, tax and net update, then approve and pay the run.
Tick several expense claims to approve or reject them together, with Undo in the toast.
Renew certificates in a staff profile, ask for contract signatures and upload documents with expiry dates.
Move money between bank accounts or add a manual cash entry and see the chart move.
